methods.name: ENCO
methods.protocol_description: ENCO learns a causal graph by modeling a probability for every possible directed edge. It alternates between distribution fitting (training neural networks to model conditional distributions) and graph fitting (optimizing edge probabilities by comparing graph samples on generalization from observational to interventional data). Edge orientation is a separate parameter, avoiding acyclicity constraints.
